agent_notes: Government directory identity, Lucknow campus address, official homepage, current degree/doctoral catalogue, and value-added certificate catalogue were independently verified.
The managed proxy returned the exact self-signed certificate-chain error on normal TLS; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected government and official domains.
The two official language-certification pages currently render the site's value-added certificate table without language-specific duration or eligibility; no language-specific facts were invented.
Career mappings were reviewed against assets/data/career_path.db using read-only SQLite queries; the database was not edited.
